You can connect to any hub with the **hubUtils** and **hubData** R packages or the
**hubdata** Python package, and be assured that all the data within the hub are
**validated** against the [**hub data standards**](/tools/data.qmd).

**In R:**

 - **connect to hub data** with [`hubData::connect_hub()`](https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubData/reference/connect_hub.html)
 - **connect to a hub on S3** with [`hubData::s3_bucket()`](https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubData/reference/s3_bucket.html)
 - **transform** your existing data with [`hubUtils::as_model_out_tbl()`](https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubUtils/reference/as_model_out_tbl.html)

**In Python:**

 - **connect to hub data** with [`hubdata.connect_hub()`](https://hubverse-org.github.io/hub-data/usage.html)
 - **read the model output** as a PyArrow table with `HubConnection.to_table()`
 - **connect to target data** with `hubdata.connect_target_data()`
